sentence: This project tests whether commensal microbiota contribute to abnormal bone formation in soft tissues, a process called heterotopic ossification.
This project studies whether the length, methylation and purity of a repeat expansion in a gene may modify amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia.
This project uses modeling approaches to study causal pathways leading to e-cigarette use among youth and young adults.
This project builds a mobile screening tool that uses standard photographs to detect craniosynostosis in primary care.
This project studies neural oscillations in different variants of primary progressive aphasia, a disorder of speech and language, using magnetoencephalography.
This project studies how the chemical structure of DNA surfactant conjugates can be tuned to help therapeutic nucleic acids reach the cytosol of cells.
This project builds informatics services and data resources that support clinical and translational research investigators.
This project follows patients who decline randomization in trials comparing coronary artery bypass grafting and percutaneous coronary intervention.
This project builds programmable enzymes that can label, modify and manipulate endogenous proteins.
This project uses zebrafish and mouse models to study how stem cells form the connective tissues of the jaw joint.
This project builds a 3D bioprinted tissue chip of the feto-maternal interface to test drug compounds for treating pregnant women and their fetuses.
This project tries to find out how a transcription factor controls gene expression in the ocular lens.
This project develops nanomedicines that kill therapeutic-resistant ovarian cancer cells and reprogram the tumor microenvironment to enhance cancer immunotherapy.
This project brings together cancer research on risk, risk behaviors, cancer care delivery and policy to control cancer and improve population health.
This project uses single-molecule imaging in a cell-free extract to find out how cells choose between pathways that repair DNA double strand breaks.
This project tests whether therapeutic agents using autophagy-targeting chimera can degrade a protein in castrate-resistant prostate cancer.
This project acquires a liquid chromatography triple quadrupole mass spectrometer to support biomedical and arctic research on hibernation and endurance exercise.
This project develops mass spectrometry assays to monitor markers of pancreatic endocrine and exocrine function in type 1 diabetes.
This project uses mouse models to study how a protein promotes the spread of prostate cancer and impairs the immune system.
This project studies the structure and mechanism of assembly-line polyketide synthases, large enzymes that make complex natural products including many antibiotics.
